name: Shōwa (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shōwa village emblem in white: a winged device of horizontal bars beneath a ring with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Shōwa, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 1967.

features.role: Shōwa village emblem — a winged device of horizontal bars beneath a ring with a pointed top
